name_note: GTDB places this species in Anaerotignum_A, a split of the genus Anaerotignum under which it was described.

sentences.text: Anaerotignum faecicola was proposed as a novel species of the genus Anaerotignum for strain KGMB 03357, a strictly anaerobic bacterium isolated from the faeces of a healthy Korean.
Cells of that strain are Gram-stain-positive, non-motile, non-spore-forming, straight or curved rods, and the isolate grew at 10 to 45 degrees Celsius with an optimum of 40 degrees.
In a randomized trial in healthy young men, oral prednisolone was reported to decrease Anaerotignum faecicola together with Dysosmobacter welbionis.
